search_records.title: BW-002 · Authority boundaries and content admission
search_records.text: Make documented state ownership and enabled-content compatibility enforceable boundaries. Stable IDs, version domains, command/result contracts, public/private projections and package admission; evolve only the contracts needed by enabled features, without freezing every future message. In Progress The boundary review names an owner and lifecycle for movement, combat, durable assets, builds and client presentation, preserving documented invariants. Admission accepts a compatible package and rejects unknown references, invalid targeting/resource fields and incompatible versions before enabling its records. Unbound named behavior cannot be enabled by interpreting free-text intent; unsupported records produce explicit findings. Compatibility fixtures preserve existing identifiers and serialized values and separate content, rules and database revisions. Before enabling vendor/crafting/conversion routes, the complete enabled price and conversion graph passes the documented no-unlimited-guaranteed-loop gate; missing required values keep affected routes disabled. Positive and negative fixture graphs demonstrate this admission rule.

search_records.title: BW-002-T01 · Record authority owners and state lifecycles
search_records.text: BW-002 Complete BW-002-AC-1 Create docs/architecture/authority-boundaries.md in GAME_ROOT. Inspect the current scenes/bootstrap.gd, scenes/server/server_root.gd, scenes/server/server_configuration.gd and tools/run_baseline.py; distinguish these implemented bootstrap owners from future world, session and durable owners. Map movement/collision and combat resources, casts, cooldowns, statuses, summons and debt to the owning world process; map items, currency, applied builds and progression to their canonical durable records; map interpolation, animation, rendering and audio to client presentation. Record command entry, authoritative mutation, recipient projection and teardown/recovery responsibility for each. Name the one-session-epoch invariant, durable acknowledgement boundary, transfer/reconnect fencing, and build-change preservation of resources/cooldowns/debt. Describe required future lifecycle behavior without implementing those systems or claiming a database exists. Link the canonical contracts and identify the narrow admission/serialization owners to be added by this epic. Keep bootstrap build_revision and configuration rules_version/content_version ownership intact; document database revision as a distinct future storage compatibility domain, not an invented ServerConfiguration field. The map names exactly one authoritative owner and lifecycle for every domain in BW-002-AC-1, including creation, mutation, build changes, disconnect/reconnect, transfer, death and recovery where applicable. Each implemented owner links to the actual game file; each missing owner is explicitly future work. No client presentation or transport adapter is authorized to commit gameplay or economic outcomes. A review traces client intent through world validation, durable mutation where needed and filtered presentation; it records epoch fencing and preserved cooldown/resource/debt and economic ownership invariants without introducing competing mutable state.
